[LADP.8.6.1] A kwarg declared with a schema, or with the kind `Schema`
([LGRA.23.2]), takes a **fact**: its argument must be a pattern binding, so
the fact is one working memory holds. A kwarg declared with a schema takes a
binding of that schema; one declared `Schema` takes a binding of any schema.
Any other argument is a compile error (`DS_VALIDATE_FACT_KWARG_NOT_BINDING`).
No form constructs a schema value inline: a fact that working memory never held
has no meaning.

The call carries the fact as a `FactExternal` ([RFCS.23]), so the adapter
receives the fact's value and none of the engine's state.
